title: Deadly Channeller Gloves

sources.title: Arcane Critical
markers: | description = Magically augment your ability to annihilate your foes with powerful attacks. The number you need to [[Attack Roll|roll]] a [[Critical Hit]] while attacking is reduced by 2. This effect can stack.

summary: Arcane Critical lowers the critical-hit threshold for 1 turn. The pinned source reports a reduction of 1.

fields.Base value: 240 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.
fields.Arcane Critical: Bonus Action on yourself. The linked action lists a level 1 spell slot. For 1 turn, reduce the critical threshold by 1, stacking with similar effects. The tooltip says 2, but the source reports the actual reduction is 1.
